set: SS10 Conference sponsor marks (fictional companies, transparent)
alt: (empty: decorative, the sponsor's name is beside it)
prompt:
Use: the symbol mark of a made-up company on a conference's sponsors page, shown 32 to 64 px tall above the company's name, on a light surface in light mode and a dark surface in dark mode.
Subject: the mark of Northwind Freight, a shipping company: a sail-like triangle leaning into the wind over a single wave.
Details: a mid blue triangle, a teal wave beneath it, a small amber sun-dot.
Composition: one symbol centred, filling about 80% of the canvas, simple enough to read at 32 px.
Style: flat geometric symbol mark, two or three bold flat colour shapes with crisp edges, no gradients, no outlines, no texture; mid-tone saturated colours that stay visible on both a light and a dark surface, never black, never white, never very dark navy.
Constraints: isolated mark on a fully transparent background; no backdrop, no badge or circle behind it unless it is part of the mark, no cast shadow, no checkerboard, no frame; no text, no letters, no initials, no numbers, no watermark, not resembling any real company's logo.
